title: Initial gas pressure
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the initial gas pressure using force balance on piston B, including atmospheric pressure and the weight of both pistons.

title: Final gas pressure
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the final gas pressure when the spring is compressed, using force balance on piston B including the spring force and weights.

title: Ideal gas law application
description: Important: Applies the ideal gas law (pV = nRT) to relate the initial and final states of the enclosed gas, correctly identifying constant n.

title: Volume ratio calculation
description: Important: Correctly determines the initial and final volumes of the enclosed gas based on the given distances and piston area.

title: Force balance setup
description: Important: Sets up the static equilibrium condition for piston B, considering forces from gas pressure, atmosphere, spring, and gravity.

title: Spring force inclusion
description: Important: Correctly incorporates Hooke's law for the spring force in the final equilibrium, using the correct compression distance.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Converts all quantities (cm, cm², kg) to consistent SI units (m, m², kg) before calculations.

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in the force balance equation, e.g., misplacing the direction of the spring force or atmospheric pressure.

title: Incorrect volume or area
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect height for the gas volume or misinterprets the cross-sectional area, leading to wrong pressure or temperature.
